IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Haugen, Swecker, McAuliffe, Benton and Rasmussen

Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing Washington state patrol longevity bonuses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to Washington state patrol longevity bonuses; andadding a new section to chapter 43.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to the availability of amounts appropriated for thisspecific purpose, any individual who completes trooper basic trainingafter January 1, 2007, and serves a continuous commission with theWashington state patrol of at least four years is eligible, subject tothe chief's discretion, to receive a onetime longevity bonus of fivethousand dollars.
